options.description: The name of the streaming job
name: --job-name
--name
-n

options.description: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using az configure --defaults group=<name>
name: --resource-group
-g

options.description: The maximum tolerable delay in seconds where events arriving late could be included. Supported range is -1 to 1814399 (20.23:59:59 days) and -1 is used to specify wait indefinitely. If the property is absent, it is interpreted to have a value of -1
options.name: --arrival-max-delay

options.description: Controls certain runtime behaviors of the streaming job
options.name: --compatibility-level

options.description: Valid values are JobStorageAccount and SystemAccount. If set to JobStorageAccount, this requires the user to also specify jobStorageAccount property
options.name: --content-storage-policy

options.description: The data locale of the stream analytics job. Value should be the name of a supported .NET Culture from the set https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.globalization.culturetypes(v=vs.110).aspx. Defaults to 'en-US' if none specified
options.name: --data-locale

options.description: A list of one or more functions for the streaming job. The name property for each function is required when specifying this property in a PUT request. This property cannot be modify via a PATCH operation. You must use the PATCH API available for the individual transformation. Expected value: json-string/json-file/@json-file
options.name: --functions

options.description: The resource id of cluster
options.name: --id

options.description: Describe the system-assigned managed identity assigned to this job that can be used to authenticate with inputs and outputs
options.name: --identity

options.description: The ETag of the streaming job. Omit this value to always overwrite the current record set. Specify the last-seen ETag value to prevent accidentally overwriting concurrent changes
options.name: --if-match

options.description: Set to '*' to allow a new streaming job to be created, but to prevent updating an existing record set. Other values will result in a 412 Pre-condition Failed response
options.name: --if-none-match

options.description: A list of one or more inputs to the streaming job. The name property for each input is required when specifying this property in a PUT request. This property cannot be modify via a PATCH operation. You must use the PATCH API available for the individual input. Expected value: json-string/json-file/@json-file
options.name: --inputs

options.description: The properties that are associated with an Azure Storage account with MSI
options.name: --job-storage-account

options.description: Describes the type of the job. Valid modes are Cloud and 'Edge'
options.name: --job-type

options.description: Location. Values from: az account list-locations. You can configure the default location using az configure --defaults location=<location>
name: --location
-l

options.description: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish
options.name: --no-wait

options.description: The maximum tolerable delay in seconds where out-of-order events can be adjusted to be back in order
options.name: --order-max-delay

options.description: Indicates the policy to apply to events that arrive out of order in the input event stream
options.name: --out-of-order-policy

options.description: Indicates the policy to apply to events that arrive at the output and cannot be written to the external storage due to being malformed (missing column values, column values of wrong type or size)
options.name: --output-error-policy

options.description: This property should only be utilized when it is desired that the job be started immediately upon creation. Value may be JobStartTime, CustomTime, or LastOutputEventTime to indicate whether the starting point of the output event stream should start whenever the job is started, start at a custom user time stamp specified via the outputStartTime property, or start from the last event output time
options.name: --output-start-mode

options.description: Value is either an ISO-8601 formatted time stamp that indicates the starting point of the output event stream, or null to indicate that the output event stream will start whenever the streaming job is started. This property must have a value if outputStartMode is set to CustomTime
options.name: --output-start-time

options.description: A list of one or more outputs for the streaming job. The name property for each output is required when specifying this property in a PUT request. This property cannot be modify via a PATCH operation. You must use the PATCH API available for the individual output. Expected value: json-string/json-file/@json-file
options.name: --outputs

options.description: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value] ...]. Use "" to clear existing tags
options.name: --tags

options.description: Indicate the query and the number of streaming units to use for the streaming job. The name property of the transformation is required when specifying this property in a PUT request. This property cannot be modify via a PATCH operation. You must use the PATCH API available for the individual transformation
options.name: --transformation
